meta.title: Privacy Policy - Antiwordle
meta.description: Read the Antiwordle Privacy Policy to understand local storage, data use, and contact information.

sections.title: Information stored on your device
body: Antiwordle uses browser localStorage to remember game progress, settings, streaks, personal bests, and whether you have seen the introductory screen.
This information is stored in your browser and is used to make the game work across visits.

sections.title: Analytics and advertising
body: This rebuilt version does not include advertising scripts or analytics scripts.

sections.title: Policy updates
body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the site changes. The latest version will be published on this page.
